import numpy as np

# Get the poses and extents of the red and green cubes
red_pose, red_quaternion, red_extent = get_object_pose("red cube", return_bbox_extent=True)
green_pose, green_quaternion, green_extent = get_object_pose("green cube", return_bbox_extent=True)

# Sample a grasp pose for the red cube
red_grasp_pose, red_grasp_quaternion = sample_grasp_pose("red cube")

# Approach the red cube for grasping
goto_pose(red_grasp_pose, red_grasp_quaternion, z_approach=0.1)

# Close the gripper to grasp the red cube
close_gripper()

# Lift the red cube to a safe height
red_grasp_pose[2] += 0.2
goto_pose(red_grasp_pose, red_grasp_quaternion)

# Calculate the placement position for the red cube
place_z = green_pose[2] + green_extent[2]/2 + red_extent[2]/2
red_place_pose = np.array([green_pose[0], green_pose[1], place_z])
red_place_quaternion = red_grasp_quaternion  # Reuse the grasp quaternion for placement

# Approach the placement position for placing
goto_pose(red_place_pose, red_place_quaternion, z_approach=0.1)

# Open the gripper to release the red cube
open_gripper()
